reviews.text: Elka is the greatest!!  She trims my cat for me and I feel we are friends.  The staff here a very nice too!

Very disappointing experience recently. I have taken my dog to wash him here a few times and had positive experiences every time. But this last time, I went looking for cat supplies and was so disappointed in the selection they have here. They have only one shampoo geared for cats, and it is a waterless shampoo. Cats need baths sometimes too especially when they are rescues. This place doesn't even have any grooming supplies (or at least the apathetic employee didn't know of any). The employee seemed to find it amusing that I was disappointed as well, indicated by him chuckling under his breath. I might not be back based on this experience alone.

I had a really great experience at Pet Planet thanks to Gracie (Grace)! She was incredibly kind, patient, and genuinely helpful from the moment I walked in. She took the time to answer all my questions, made thoughtful recommendations, and didn’t make me feel rushed at all. You can tell she truly cares about both the customers and the animals.

It’s not often you come across someone with such a positive attitude and willingness to go the extra mile. Because of her, my visit was easy and enjoyable. Pet Planet is lucky to have her!
Destiny and Sierra have gone above and beyond with customer service,  my dog bubbles gives you 5 stars. They are the best.
This is the best place for pets. They offer a good selection pf healthy food and No CRAP plus they offer grooming services. You can DIY or make an appointment with their groomer.  She's the BEST!
Card reader NEVER works. They don't fix it and don't care. Tried to use my card numerous times yesterday also came back to try again today.... Nope so Frustrating!!!

Very cute niche  pet food attire.  Has many  specialty dog and cat food options. I needed some high quality  puppy food. I couldn't help but get a few thing from their great assortment of treats and bones. Which was displayed in a cute salad bar pick and go set-up. Only down side was that they don't sell any leather collars, which is one of the 2 items i went in to purchase.  Great staff, young, friendly a knowledgeable. I will definitely be back when I get low on food for my lil guy,
The staff is always friendly, knowledgeable about their products and just pleasant to speak with.

I have been bringing my bulldog here for the last 10 years since he was a puppy.  (I guess that's closer to 9 years?)

From the start the staff is welcoming and friendly when they see us.  Everyone knows him by name.  There have been a few changes in who manages the store, but everyone who manages has been EXTREMELY friendly.  Ownership clearly cares about staffing people that love dogs and are happy to be around them.

They all appear to be knowledgeable on basic nutrition, albeit not a substitute for your vet, but they aren't people who "just work there".  They will give you input if you have any questions.

The store has a policy of ensuring they are only carrying things that are healthy for your animal, and are on top of their game in terms of recalls.

Support this business!  They are good people.
Just came to get some dog food and it was free!  They give you your 12th bag.  P cool.  I get the hooves here for my furry friend when they have the 10% off deal by the dozen.

Only issue, I had with this place. They did not offer a military discount. Or a  first-time customer incentive.
Don't support our Veterans. Sad 😢 …
Needed a particular brand. Didn't stock it.
